name: gezel
description: Build a crew of named AI companions with distinct roles and tools, then put them to work on your projects. Gezel stores their conversations, memory, and work on your computer as ordinary files.

scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel run build && pnpm -r --filter @bendyline/gezel-client --filter @bendyline/gezel-plugin-sdk --filter @bendyline/gezel-sdk --filter @bendyline/gezel-app-sdk --filter @bendyline/gezel-catalog --filter @bendyline/gezel-connectors-spectral run build && pnpm -r --filter @bendyline/gezel-mcp --filter @bendyline/gezel-ui run build && pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-service run build && pnpm -r --filter @bendyline/gezel-cli --filter @bendyline/gezel-app --filter @bendyline/gezel-vscode run build
scripts.build:packaged: pnpm build && pnpm stage:licenses && pnpm build:bundle
scripts.rebuild: pnpm clean && pnpm install && pnpm build
scripts.app: node scripts/dev-fresh-runtime.mjs && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-app exec electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.app:clean: node scripts/dev-fresh-runtime.mjs && pnpm rebuild && pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-app exec electron . --no-sandbox
scripts.cli: test -f packages/cli/dist/bin/gezel.js || pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-cli run build; GEZEL_DEV=1 node packages/cli/dist/bin/gezel.js
scripts.cli:fresh: pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-cli run build && GEZEL_DEV=1 node packages/cli/dist/bin/gezel.js
scripts.cli:tui: pnpm bootstrap && pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-cli... run build && node scripts/run-cli-tui.mjs
scripts.test:stability: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter @bendyline/gezel-ui --filter @bendyline/gezel-service run test && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 --filter @bendyline/gezel-ui --filter @bendyline/gezel-service run test
scripts.test:e2e:desktop:smoke: pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-app exec playwright test app.spec.ts supervisor-spawn.spec.ts --reporter=line --retries=0 --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e:web:smoke: pnpm --filter @bendyline/gezel-app exec playwright test --config playwright.web.config.ts shell.spec.ts write-flow.spec.ts --reporter=line --retries=0 --repeat-each=3 --workers=1
scripts.validate: pnpm check:local-links && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:stability && pnpm test:coverage && pnpm test:published && pnpm check:packages && pnpm test:e2e:run && pnpm test:e2e:desktop:smoke && pnpm pw:install && pnpm test:e2e:web:run && pnpm test:e2e:web:smoke && pnpm build:bundle
scripts.lint: biome check . && pnpm check:workflows && node scripts/check-markdown-links.mjs && node scripts/check-notice.mjs && node scripts/check-path-safety.mjs && node scripts/check-module-size.mjs
